LocalMatch creates HeroBot({team:1,slotIndex:0}); LocalMatch.step passes simulation.commandFrame([...playerCommands,...bot.think(simulation)]) to simulation.step().

observation.reproducible: Two independent page loads produced identical tick-13 bot position, consistent with the fixed seed.

botAdvance.conclusion: Bot hero id 10 (team 1) advanced 14.467 units toward moveGoal x=-28 between tick 13 and tick 75 while the team-0 player hero stayed at spawn with no input.
